message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will give you an extra day off, creating a three‑day weekend):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sun | Yes (already a weekend) |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 | Mon | Yes |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | Yes |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | Yes |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Tue | Yes |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | Yes |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 | Mon | Yes |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Wed | No (unless you’re in a province that observes it as a statutory holiday) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | Yes |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tue | Yes |

**Note:** Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, or the Civic Holiday in most provinces). If you want a complete list for each province, let me know!
